purpose: Define contextual relevance policy used by Broker matching without imposing a hidden global weighting function on MeritCore or PortfolioCore.

topics.name: Broker Relevance Policy
topics.purpose: Define contextual relevance policy used by Broker matching without imposing a hidden global weighting function on MeritCore or PortfolioCore.

semantics.policy_rule: Relevance criteria/weights/filters are explicit Broker policy.
semantics.context_rule: Relevance may vary by Project, role, competence criterion or market query context.
semantics.merit_rule: Broker relevance never rewrites stored global MeritCore points/Tier/trust.
semantics.recency_rule: Recency may be used only when the relevant competence/Project policy explicitly requires it; there is no generic hidden decay.
semantics.version_rule: Policy identity/version is explicit and included in match provenance.
semantics.explain_rule: Machine-significant ranking factors are traceable enough to explain the evidence basis for a result.
semantics.no_global_rule: No universal global weighting is implied merely because Broker ranks candidates.

invariants.rule: FreeMarket/Broker matching and ranking operate over explicit Project, identity, PortfolioCore and MeritCore semantics without creating duplicate work, identity or merit authority.

hard_gates.condition: generic time decay introduced through matching
ranking factors hidden where policy claims explainability
one contextual relevance policy treated as universal global merit weighting

references.purpose: Broker relevance is separate from MeritCore point calculation.

prose.summary: Define contextual relevance policy used by Broker matching without imposing a hidden global weighting function on MeritCore or PortfolioCore.
